import numpy as np

def relu(z):
    return np.maximum(0, z)

def relu_derivative(z):
    return (z > 0).astype(float)

# --- Inputs from Laboratory Task 2 ---
x = np.array([1, 0, 1], dtype=float)   # shape (3,)
y = np.array([1], dtype=float)         # shape (1,)

# Initial hidden weights (3 inputs -> 2 hidden units)
W1 = np.array([
    [0.2, -0.3],
    [0.4,  0.1],
    [-0.5, 0.2]
])  # shape (3, 2)

# Hidden biases
b1 = np.array([-0.4, 0.2])  # shape (2,)

# Initial output weights (2 hidden -> 1 output)
W2 = np.array([
    [-0.3],
    [-0.2]
])  # shape (2, 1)

# Output bias
b2 = np.array([0.1])  # shape (1,)

# Learning rate
lr = 0.001

# ---------- Forward pass ----------
z1 = x @ W1 + b1               # shape (2,)
h = relu(z1)                   # shape (2,)
z2 = h @ W2 + b2               # shape (1,)
y_hat = relu(z2)               # shape (1,)

# Loss (half MSE for a single sample)
loss = 0.5 * np.sum((y - y_hat) ** 2)

# ---------- Backward pass ----------
# Gradient of loss w.r.t. z2
delta2 = (y_hat - y) * relu_derivative(z2)   # shape (1,)

# Gradients for output layer
dW2 = h.reshape(2, 1) @ delta2.reshape(1, 1)  # shape (2, 1)
db2 = delta2                                  # shape (1,)

# Backpropagate to hidden layer
delta1 = (delta2 @ W2.T).flatten() * relu_derivative(z1)  # shape (2,)

# Gradients for hidden layer
dW1 = x.reshape(3, 1) @ delta1.reshape(1, 2)  # shape (3, 2)
db1 = delta1                                  # shape (2,)

# ---------- Update weights ----------
W2_new = W2 - lr * dW2
b2_new = b2 - lr * db2
W1_new = W1 - lr * dW1
b1_new = b1 - lr * db1

# ---------- Output ----------
print("Forward pass:")
print("z1 =", z1)
print("h  =", h)
print("z2 =", z2)
print("y_hat =", y_hat)
print("loss =", loss)
print()
print("Backward pass:")
print("delta2 =", delta2)
print("dW2 =", dW2)
print("db2 =", db2)
print("delta1 =", delta1)
print("dW1 =", dW1)
print("db1 =", db1)
print()
print("Updated weights:")
print("W2_new =\n", W2_new)
print("b2_new =", b2_new)
print("W1_new =\n", W1_new)
print("b1_new =", b1_new)
